reason: comparator not buildable pre-freeze -- register 1.6 resolution rule (v6.6): R-d (v6.8, applied uniformly -- the orchestrator under the operator's standing delegation, decided after the v6.7 final re-check, post hoc, declared): the paper's names for the set ('asdM12 from 118', 'ASD downregulated') reach no list under the cited sources' own names -- ref 118 (Voineagu 2011) calls the module 'M12' and prints its genes (Supplementary Table 14), and 'asdM12' is Parikshak 2013's name for it (ref 123, which Buch cites for 'ID All', not for this set); ref 119 (Parikshak 2016) holds no list named asdM12 (its CTX.M12 is its own rWGCNA module). Table 14's list is the near-miss view's comparator (register 1.6, v6.8)
